correctness.rationale: For a fixed simplicial matching of k edges in s reflection edge-orbits, simplex orientation sign (−1)^{k−s} times reduced chain sign (−1)^{k−1} is (−1)^{s+1}, including augmented empty face contribution −1. For top-bottom reflection vertical edge pairs intersect and are forbidden; horizontal upper/lower orbits and fixed middle edges yield two independent signed path matching counts a_n². For left-right reflection, odd central column contributes (1−2)=−1 while off-axis orbits correspond to left 3×m matchings; even middle seam cancels except last-column-saturating half-matchings. Independently built 8×8 transfer matrix with signed horizontal selection and at-most-one vertical edge, and exactly inverted I−zT, obtaining BOTH claimed rational F,Q functions (degree-six denominator). Independent edge-orbit enumerator gives row/column Lefschetz n=2..7 = (0,0), (−1,−1),(−1,1),(0,2),(−1,−1),(−1,−5). The universal proof is the orbit decomposition and exact formal matrix identity, not finite enumeration.
